VIVHITE_RELIC_ORIGIN_STAR_CHART.title: Origin Star Chart
VIVHITE_RELIC_ORIGIN_STAR_CHART.descript: Whenever any enemy dies, immediately heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP. The same death event from the same entity triggers only once; different enemies trigger separately. There is no limit on triggers or total healing.
VIVHITE_RELIC_ORIGIN_STAR_CHART.flavor: Every fallen star returns a little light to the magician who mapped its orbit.
